title: lattice.todo_witness_set.v3
description: Per-ToDo boundary declaration compiled into a recorded independence judgement (ADR 0127). Each entry declares what the ToDo owns, reads and writes so that pairwise interference can be decided before dispatch. v2 added the optional concern_anchors declaration, which binds seam candidates and never participates in the independence judgement. v3 adds the optional creates marker on an owned path: the ToDo declares that the path does not exist yet and that it will create it (ADR 0136). Unlike concern_anchors, creates does participate in the judgement — it is what makes a not-yet-existing boundary decidable instead of unknown.
$comment: Runtime validation additionally enforces canonical JSON+LF bytes and the self-digest rule, and delegates manual_witness and sensor_query_set to explainRunRequest so the witness contract is not duplicated (ADR 0123). concern_anchors is stripped before that synthesis, so its non-influence on the judgement is structural rather than asserted. Declaring nothing is not an assertion of independence: an undeclared ToDo compiles to unknown, never to verified. v1 declarations stay valid input and simply cannot carry concern_anchors. creates is carried into the synthesized run request rather than stripped, because the judgement itself needs it; a declared creation is only honoured when the sensor freshly observes the path as absent and reports no affected tests, so the declaration cannot invent structural backing. A misspelled path that was never declared as a creation still fails closed exactly as before. v1 and v2 declarations stay valid input and simply cannot carry creates.

sensor_query_set.description: Sensor queries backing the declarations. Exactly one query must have operation 'status'.

manual_witness.description: Keyed by task_id of the plan. Keys must be a subset of the plan's tasks.

repoRelativePath.description: Repo-relative path. Absolute paths, backslashes and '..' traversal are rejected. A trailing '/' declares a directory prefix and is accepted only under 'writes'.

owns.description: Symbols and paths this ToDo claims ownership of. Every entry needs a covering sensor query or it compiles to a sensor_unbound unknown. An entry may additionally declare creates: true for a path this ToDo will bring into existence.

creates.description: Optional. Declares that this path does not exist yet and that this ToDo creates it. Only valid when kind is path — existence is a filesystem fact and a symbol has none of its own. Only the value true is accepted: false would be a second spelling of an existing path. Omitted is the default.

resources.description: Shared resource ids. A resource with no matching state_effect entry is treated as a shared resource of unknown direction and becomes a conflict.

affected_tests.description: Declared affected tests. Compared exactly against fresh sensor observation; any drift fails the compile rather than being narrowed.

unknowns.description: Explicitly declared residual unknowns. Recorded, never rounded away.

concern_anchors.description: Optional. Which named symbols inside an owned-but-contested resource are this ToDo's concern. Consumed only when binding seam candidates; it can never create, remove or alter a conflict, so a dishonest declaration degrades the proposal without touching the judgement. Declared symbols must resolve through the sensor with an exact name and path match, must live inside the declared resource, and must not overlap another ToDo's declaration for the same resource; any breach yields a typed unknown instead of a proposal.

within.description: The contested resource. Must be a resource this same ToDo claims under 'owns'.

symbols.description: Symbol names owned by this ToDo inside the resource. Strictly sorted and unique.
